topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: Oh wow, can you even believe it? My kid, of all the teachers in this big, wide world, gets stuck with the same one I had! It’s like stepping back in time, but this time I’m the one doing the worrying instead of sitting there in class. I mean, I know Mrs. Thompson means well, but she was so strict, always had that precise way of doing things. Now, here we are, and I’m thinking about all the old stories, the incidents that still make me cringe. I hope my little one doesn’t inherit my old habits, you know? What if they have to go through what I did? I guess all I can do is talk to them, maybe share a laugh or two about the old days, and cross my fingers it all turns out better.
